description_en: A Pokémon that eats soil. Once it has eaten a large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.
description_pt: A Pokémon that eats soil. Once it has eaten a large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.

name: Pupitar
description_en: Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.
description_pt: Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.

name: Tyranitar
description_en: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.
description_pt: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

name: Lugia
description_en: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.
description_pt: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.

name: Ho-Oh
description_en: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.
description_pt: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.

name: Celebi
description_en: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.
description_pt: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.

name: Treecko
description_en: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.
description_pt: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.

name: Grovyle
description_en: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.
description_pt: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

name: Sceptile
description_en: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.
description_pt: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.

name: Torchic
description_en: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.
description_pt: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.

name: Combusken
description_en: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.
description_pt: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.

name: Blaziken
description_en: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.
description_pt: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.

name: Mudkip
description_en: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.
description_pt: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

name: Marshtomp
description_en: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.
description_pt: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.

name: Swampert
description_en: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.
description_pt: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.

name: Poochyena
description_en: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.
description_pt: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

name: Mightyena
description_en: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.
description_pt: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.

name: Zigzagoon
description_en: It walks in zigzag fashion. It is good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.
description_pt: It walks in zigzag fashion. It is good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.

name: Linoone
description_en: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.
description_pt: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.

name: Wurmple
description_en: Likes sap and is abundant in the wild. Why it evolves into various different forms is unknown. One cannot tell from a Wurmple's appearance which form it will take when it evolves.
description_pt: Likes sap and is abundant in the wild. Why it evolves into various different forms is unknown. One cannot tell from a Wurmple's appearance which form it will take when it evolves.

name: Silcoon
description_en: Wraps itself in thin strings of silk while it stores energy for evolution. It can't extend its limbs and its movement is slow, but its eyes keep a sharp lookout—Silcoon is always on guard.
description_pt: Wraps itself in thin strings of silk while it stores energy for evolution. It can't extend its limbs and its movement is slow, but its eyes keep a sharp lookout—Silcoon is always on guard.

name: Beautifly
description_en: A colorful and incredibly beautiful but also greedy Pokémon. In an effort to keep its favorite food all to itself, it will chase away Combee as they try to gather nectar.
description_pt: A colorful and incredibly beautiful but also greedy Pokémon. In an effort to keep its favorite food all to itself, it will chase away Combee as they try to gather nectar.

name: Cascoon
description_en: The silk coating its body is thin but sufficiently strong. Cascoon's silk has a luster and texture superior to that of Silcoon's, and clothes made using Cascoon silk are regarded as top-notch.
description_pt: The silk coating its body is thin but sufficiently strong. Cascoon's silk has a luster and texture superior to that of Silcoon's, and clothes made using Cascoon silk are regarded as top-notch.

name: Dustox
description_en: Tends to be drawn to bonfires on dark nights. Difficult to chase away from settlements because of the way it scatters highly toxic scales.
description_pt: Tends to be drawn to bonfires on dark nights. Difficult to chase away from settlements because of the way it scatters highly toxic scales.

name: Lotad
description_en: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can’t swim.
description_pt: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can’t swim.

name: Lombre
description_en: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.
description_pt: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

name: Ludicolo
description_en: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can’t help breaking out into a dance.
description_pt: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can’t help breaking out into a dance.

name: Seedot
description_en: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.
description_pt: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

name: Nuzleaf
description_en: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.
description_pt: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.

name: Shiftry
description_en: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.
description_pt: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.

name: Taillow
description_en: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.
description_pt: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

name: Swellow
description_en: It circles the sky in search of prey. When it spots one, it dives steeply to catch the prey.
description_pt: It circles the sky in search of prey. When it spots one, it dives steeply to catch the prey.

name: Wingull
description_en: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.
description_pt: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.

name: Pelipper
description_en: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.
description_pt: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.

name: Ralts
description_en: Tends to prefer people with a chipper disposition to those who are gloomy, but it has shown no discrimination with regard to age or gender. Needs more research.
description_pt: Tends to prefer people with a chipper disposition to those who are gloomy, but it has shown no discrimination with regard to age or gender. Needs more research.

name: Kirlia
description_en: It resembles a maiden in appearance, but it wields strange powers to project visions of paradise. I suspect the crimson ornaments on its head are the key to its abilities.
description_pt: It resembles a maiden in appearance, but it wields strange powers to project visions of paradise. I suspect the crimson ornaments on its head are the key to its abilities.

name: Gardevoir
description_en: It will dedicate itself to defending a master it has come to adore. Its pure white dress, reminiscent of those worn by ladies of nobility, is the dress of one who is willing to risk their life.
description_pt: It will dedicate itself to defending a master it has come to adore. Its pure white dress, reminiscent of those worn by ladies of nobility, is the dress of one who is willing to risk their life.

name: Surskit
description_en: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.
description_pt: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.

name: Masquerain
description_en: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.
description_pt: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.

name: Shroomish
description_en: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.
description_pt: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

name: Breloom
description_en: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.
description_pt: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

name: Slakoth
description_en: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.
description_pt: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.

name: Vigoroth
description_en: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still for even a moment.
description_pt: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still for even a moment.

name: Slaking
description_en: The world’s laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.
description_pt: The world’s laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.

name: Nincada
description_en: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.
description_pt: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.

name: Ninjask
description_en: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.
description_pt: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.

name: Shedinja
description_en: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one’s spirit.
description_pt: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one’s spirit.

name: Whismur
description_en: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.
description_pt: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.

name: Loudred
description_en: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.
description_pt: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

name: Exploud
description_en: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.
description_pt: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.

name: Makuhita
description_en: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.
description_pt: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.

name: Hariyama
description_en: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.
description_pt: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.

name: Azurill
description_en: Its tail bounces like a rubber ball. It flings that tail around to fight opponents bigger than itself.
description_pt: Its tail bounces like a rubber ball. It flings that tail around to fight opponents bigger than itself.

name: Nosepass
description_en: Once the people of Hisui discovered that its red nose always points north, they grew to rely on it greatly when traveling afar. The nose seems to work in a similar way to ancient compasses.
description_pt: Once the people of Hisui discovered that its red nose always points north, they grew to rely on it greatly when traveling afar. The nose seems to work in a similar way to ancient compasses.

name: Skitty
description_en: It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.
description_pt: It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

name: Delcatty
description_en: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.
description_pt: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

name: Sableye
description_en: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.
description_pt: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

name: Mawile
description_en: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.
description_pt: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

name: Aron
description_en: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.
description_pt: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

name: Lairon
description_en: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely body against others to fight over territory.
description_pt: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely body against others to fight over territory.

name: Aggron
description_en: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.
description_pt: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

name: Meditite
description_en: It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.
description_pt: It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.

name: Medicham
description_en: It gains the ability to see the aura of its opponents by honing its mind through starvation.
description_pt: It gains the ability to see the aura of its opponents by honing its mind through starvation.

name: Electrike
description_en: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.
description_pt: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

name: Manectric
description_en: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.
description_pt: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

name: Plusle
description_en: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.
description_pt: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

name: Minun
description_en: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.
description_pt: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

name: Volbeat
description_en: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves ILLUMISE’s sweet aroma.
description_pt: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves ILLUMISE’s sweet aroma.

name: Illumise
description_en: With its sweet aroma, it guides VOLBEAT to draw signs with light in the night sky.
description_pt: With its sweet aroma, it guides VOLBEAT to draw signs with light in the night sky.

name: Roselia
description_en: Though beautiful, it has highly poisonous thorns. There is an old tradition in my homeland wherein one would send these thorns to an opponent to challenge them to a duel.
description_pt: Though beautiful, it has highly poisonous thorns. There is an old tradition in my homeland wherein one would send these thorns to an opponent to challenge them to a duel.

name: Gulpin
description_en: Almost all its body is its stomach. Its harsh digestive juices quickly dissolve anything it swallows.
description_pt: Almost all its body is its stomach. Its harsh digestive juices quickly dissolve anything it swallows.

name: Swalot
description_en: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.
description_pt: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.

name: Carvanha
description_en: They swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.
description_pt: They swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.

name: Sharpedo
description_en: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as “The Bully of the Sea.”
description_pt: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as “The Bully of the Sea.”

name: Wailmer
description_en: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.
description_pt: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.

name: Wailord
description_en: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.
description_pt: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.

name: Numel
description_en: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.
description_pt: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

name: Camerupt
description_en: It has volcanoes on its back. If magma builds up in its body, it shudders, then erupts violently.
description_pt: It has volcanoes on its back. If magma builds up in its body, it shudders, then erupts violently.

name: Torkoal
description_en: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.
description_pt: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

name: Spoink
description_en: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.
description_pt: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.

name: Grumpig
description_en: It uses black pearls to amplify its psycho-power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.
description_pt: It uses black pearls to amplify its psycho-power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.

name: Spinda
description_en: No two SPINDA have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.
description_pt: No two SPINDA have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

name: Trapinch
description_en: It makes a conical pit in desert sand and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.
description_pt: It makes a conical pit in desert sand and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

name: Vibrava
description_en: It violently shudders its wings, generating ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.
description_pt: It violently shudders its wings, generating ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.

name: Flygon
description_en: It whips up sandstorms with powerful flaps of its wings. It is known as “The Desert Spirit.”
description_pt: It whips up sandstorms with powerful flaps of its wings. It is known as “The Desert Spirit.”

name: Cacnea
description_en: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive for 30 days without water.
description_pt: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive for 30 days without water.

name: Cacturne
description_en: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day’s desert heat.
description_pt: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day’s desert heat.

name: Swablu
description_en: It can’t relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.
description_pt: It can’t relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.

name: Altaria
description_en: If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.
description_pt: If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.

name: Zangoose
description_en: It has feuded with SEVIPER for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.
description_pt: It has feuded with SEVIPER for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.

name: Seviper
description_en: For many generations, it has feuded with ZANGOOSE. It whets its bladed tail on rocks for battle.
description_pt: For many generations, it has feuded with ZANGOOSE. It whets its bladed tail on rocks for battle.

name: Lunatone
description_en: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.
description_pt: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.

name: Solrock
description_en: A new Pokémon species, rumored to be from the sun. It gives off light while spinning.
description_pt: A new Pokémon species, rumored to be from the sun. It gives off light while spinning.

name: Barboach
description_en: Makes its home in swamps with murky water. The poor visibility hides this Pokémon from predators, and the slime on its body makes grasping it difficult.
description_pt: Makes its home in swamps with murky water. The poor visibility hides this Pokémon from predators, and the slime on its body makes grasping it difficult.

name: Whiscash
description_en: Strikes its caudal fin against the swamp bed to shake the ground and startle its prey. It will then swallow the fleeing prey whole. People mistook this behavior as the cause of earthquakes.
description_pt: Strikes its caudal fin against the swamp bed to shake the ground and startle its prey. It will then swallow the fleeing prey whole. People mistook this behavior as the cause of earthquakes.

name: Corphish
description_en: Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any environment. Its pincers will never release prey.
description_pt: Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any environment. Its pincers will never release prey.

name: Crawdaunt
description_en: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.
description_pt: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.

name: Baltoy
description_en: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.
description_pt: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

name: Claydol
description_en: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.
description_pt: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.

name: Lileep
description_en: It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.
description_pt: It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.

name: Cradily
description_en: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.
description_pt: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.

name: Anorith
description_en: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.
description_pt: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.

name: Armaldo
description_en: It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is clad in a sturdy armor.
description_pt: It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is clad in a sturdy armor.

name: Feebas
description_en: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.
description_pt: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

name: Milotic
description_en: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.
description_pt: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.

name: Castform
description_en: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.
description_pt: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.

name: Kecleon
description_en: It can freely change its body’s color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn’t change, however.
description_pt: It can freely change its body’s color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn’t change, however.

name: Shuppet
description_en: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.
description_pt: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

name: Banette
description_en: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.
description_pt: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.

name: Duskull
description_en: I've heard that the children of Hisui all begin to behave once they've been told the story of how this Pokémon roams about before the witching hour to spirit away misbehaving children.
description_pt: I've heard that the children of Hisui all begin to behave once they've been told the story of how this Pokémon roams about before the witching hour to spirit away misbehaving children.

name: Dusclops
description_en: There are rumors that peeking inside its bandage-wrapped body will cause one to get pulled in through the gaps between the bandages, never to return. I've been too scared to verify.
description_pt: There are rumors that peeking inside its bandage-wrapped body will cause one to get pulled in through the gaps between the bandages, never to return. I've been too scared to verify.

name: Tropius
description_en: Delicious fruits grew out from around its neck because it always ate the same kind of fruit.
description_pt: Delicious fruits grew out from around its neck because it always ate the same kind of fruit.

name: Chimecho
description_en: Can emit waves of air powerful enough to knock out prey taller than itself. I hypothesize that it amplifies the faint sound of wind within its body.
description_pt: Can emit waves of air powerful enough to knock out prey taller than itself. I hypothesize that it amplifies the faint sound of wind within its body.

name: Absol
description_en: Rumored to sense disasters with its horn, it became a target. It fled deep into the mountains.
description_pt: Rumored to sense disasters with its horn, it became a target. It fled deep into the mountains.

name: Wynaut
description_en: It grows strong by pushing up against others en masse. It loves eating sweet fruit.
description_pt: It grows strong by pushing up against others en masse. It loves eating sweet fruit.

name: Snorunt
description_en: Arrives alongside the first snow. It's thought that homes Snorunt visit will prosper for many generations. By tradition, one might offer a lump of ice made from pure water at one's front door.
description_pt: Arrives alongside the first snow. It's thought that homes Snorunt visit will prosper for many generations. By tradition, one might offer a lump of ice made from pure water at one's front door.

name: Glalie
description_en: It covers its body with an armor of ice harder than steel. Uses its breath to freeze prey, which it then devours as if they were frozen desserts.
description_pt: It covers its body with an armor of ice harder than steel. Uses its breath to freeze prey, which it then devours as if they were frozen desserts.

name: Spheal
description_en: During the season when drift ice approaches the shore, Spheal prefers living on the ice—where fewer predators lurk—rather than the land. Its fur retains heat superbly and resists harsh cold.
description_pt: During the season when drift ice approaches the shore, Spheal prefers living on the ice—where fewer predators lurk—rather than the land. Its fur retains heat superbly and resists harsh cold.

name: Sealeo
description_en: Its white whiskers are very sensitive. Sealeo will balance Spheal on the tip of its nose, checking its scent and its feel to be sure the Spheal is healthy.
description_pt: Its white whiskers are very sensitive. Sealeo will balance Spheal on the tip of its nose, checking its scent and its feel to be sure the Spheal is healthy.

name: Walrein
description_en: Its thick tusks are strong enough to shatter drift ice. They have been known to break, but they will grow back by the next year. The Hisui region is well known for these broken tusks.
description_pt: Its thick tusks are strong enough to shatter drift ice. They have been known to break, but they will grow back by the next year. The Hisui region is well known for these broken tusks.

name: Clamperl
description_en: It makes a single pearl during its lifetime. The pearl is said to amplify psychic power.
description_pt: It makes a single pearl during its lifetime. The pearl is said to amplify psychic power.

name: Huntail
description_en: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.
description_pt: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.

name: Gorebyss
description_en: It lives at the bottom of the sea. In the springtime, its pink body turns more vivid for some reason.
description_pt: It lives at the bottom of the sea. In the springtime, its pink body turns more vivid for some reason.

name: Relicanth
description_en: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.
description_pt: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.

name: Luvdisc
description_en: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.
description_pt: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.

name: Bagon
description_en: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.
description_pt: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

name: Shelgon
description_en: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.
description_pt: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.

name: Salamence
description_en: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.
description_pt: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.

name: Beldum
description_en: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.
description_pt: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.

name: Metang
description_en: It is formed by two BELDUM joining together. Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides with a jet.
description_pt: It is formed by two BELDUM joining together. Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides with a jet.

name: Metagross
description_en: METANG combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.
description_pt: METANG combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.

name: Regirock
description_en: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.
description_pt: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, it attaches rocks to repair itself.

name: Regice
description_en: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.
description_pt: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Registeel
description_en: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.
description_pt: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.

name: Latias
description_en: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.
description_pt: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.

name: Latios
description_en: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.
description_pt: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

name: Kyogre
description_en: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.
description_pt: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

name: Groudon
description_en: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought KYOGRE long ago.
description_pt: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought KYOGRE long ago.

name: Rayquaza
description_en: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.
description_pt: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

name: Jirachi
description_en: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.
description_pt: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

name: Deoxys
description_en: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.
description_pt: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

name: Turtwig
description_en: This Pokémon becomes more energetic the more sunlight there is. The part resembling a shell is similar to silt and is slightly damp and warm to the touch.
description_pt: This Pokémon becomes more energetic the more sunlight there is. The part resembling a shell is similar to silt and is slightly damp and warm to the touch.

name: Grotle
description_en: Appears where there is clean spring water. The fruit that grows on the shrubs on its shell is sweet, nutritious, and truly delicious.
description_pt: Appears where there is clean spring water. The fruit that grows on the shrubs on its shell is sweet, nutritious, and truly delicious.

name: Torterra
description_en: This remarkable, large-bodied Pokémon would serve beautifully as borrowed scenery for a garden, and its strength is peerless. Torterra roams the wilderness in search of clean water.
description_pt: This remarkable, large-bodied Pokémon would serve beautifully as borrowed scenery for a garden, and its strength is peerless. Torterra roams the wilderness in search of clean water.

name: Chimchar
description_en: Full of vigor and always in high spirits. It was once known by the name ”Lantern-Tail” and feared as some kind of apparition.
description_pt: Full of vigor and always in high spirits. It was once known by the name ”Lantern-Tail” and feared as some kind of apparition.

name: Monferno
description_en: The deeper the blue on its face, the more powerful it will grow to become. It leaps about every which way and lands powerful blows against its opponents with the flame on its tail.
description_pt: The deeper the blue on its face, the more powerful it will grow to become. It leaps about every which way and lands powerful blows against its opponents with the flame on its tail.

name: Infernape
description_en: A tall, hardy Pokémon with a dazzling appearance. It shrouds itself in flame and battles as if engaged in dance—truly a sight to behold.
description_pt: A tall, hardy Pokémon with a dazzling appearance. It shrouds itself in flame and battles as if engaged in dance—truly a sight to behold.

name: Piplup
description_en: Prefers cold climes and appears along coasts. It's an adorable little thing—as cute as any child—but it's also prideful, unwilling to accept handouts from people.
description_pt: Prefers cold climes and appears along coasts. It's an adorable little thing—as cute as any child—but it's also prideful, unwilling to accept handouts from people.

name: Prinplup
description_en: It swims gracefully through the frigid sea and sings with a voice like the roaring tide. It has powerful, sturdy wings and dignity to match.
description_pt: It swims gracefully through the frigid sea and sings with a voice like the roaring tide. It has powerful, sturdy wings and dignity to match.

name: Empoleon
description_en: Since ancient times, it has been revered by the people of Hisui, who call it the Master of the Waves. Its wings are a match for even master-crafted blades.
description_pt: Since ancient times, it has been revered by the people of Hisui, who call it the Master of the Waves. Its wings are a match for even master-crafted blades.

name: Starly
description_en: They live in the fields and mountains, gathering in large flocks. Their cries are quite obnoxious. Though small, their wings are strong—a strike from them leaves pain that persists for a week.
description_pt: They live in the fields and mountains, gathering in large flocks. Their cries are quite obnoxious. Though small, their wings are strong—a strike from them leaves pain that persists for a week.

name: Staravia
description_en: They form remarkably large flocks and are constantly fighting amongst themselves. I suspect that those with magnificent plumes on their heads are the strong ones.
description_pt: They form remarkably large flocks and are constantly fighting amongst themselves. I suspect that those with magnificent plumes on their heads are the strong ones.

name: Staraptor
description_en: It has left the flock, having gained strength enough to survive on its own. The astounding force with which Staraptor flies through the air allows it to carry away large, burly targets.
description_pt: It has left the flock, having gained strength enough to survive on its own. The astounding force with which Staraptor flies through the air allows it to carry away large, burly targets.

name: Bidoof
description_en: Bidoof has an unsophisticated face and is rarely flustered by anything. There have been incidents involving Bidoof sauntering into villages and gnawing on the houses without a single care.
description_pt: Bidoof has an unsophisticated face and is rarely flustered by anything. There have been incidents involving Bidoof sauntering into villages and gnawing on the houses without a single care.

name: Bibarel
description_en: Bibarel fur repels water and is also a fantastic material for heat retention. These Pokémon create dams on rivers to live in.
description_pt: Bibarel fur repels water and is also a fantastic material for heat retention. These Pokémon create dams on rivers to live in.

name: Kricketot
description_en: When the trees take on new hues, more of these Pokémon appear. The tone they create by striking their antennae together resembles that of the marimba, an instrument of foreign lands.
description_pt: When the trees take on new hues, more of these Pokémon appear. The tone they create by striking their antennae together resembles that of the marimba, an instrument of foreign lands.

name: Kricketune
description_en: It uses its cutlass-like arms to produce sound, the melody of which varies from individual to individual. It is a worthwhile endeavor to seek out one's favorite tunes.
description_pt: It uses its cutlass-like arms to produce sound, the melody of which varies from individual to individual. It is a worthwhile endeavor to seek out one's favorite tunes.

name: Shinx
description_en: Shakes its body to generate electricity. Its stature belies its aggression—one must be patient to tame this Pokémon.
description_pt: Shakes its body to generate electricity. Its stature belies its aggression—one must be patient to tame this Pokémon.

name: Luxio
description_en: Proudly uses its electrified claws as weapons. It seems to be a gracious Pokémon, evenly sharing the spoils of the hunt with others of its kind.
description_pt: Proudly uses its electrified claws as weapons. It seems to be a gracious Pokémon, evenly sharing the spoils of the hunt with others of its kind.

name: Luxray
description_en: They form packs, each having one male as leader. Legends say that when Luxray's two eyes shimmer with gold, the Pokémon can see through anything.
description_pt: They form packs, each having one male as leader. Legends say that when Luxray's two eyes shimmer with gold, the Pokémon can see through anything.

name: Budew
description_en: When the sun's light strengthens, the bud atop this Pokémon's head opens. This is a sign to the people that the harsh winter is over, and the season of budding has begun.
description_pt: When the sun's light strengthens, the bud atop this Pokémon's head opens. This is a sign to the people that the harsh winter is over, and the season of budding has begun.

name: Roserade
description_en: Hidden within the bouquet on each hand are thorned whips loaded with virulent poison. Roserade moves gracefully as it corners its prey and mercilessly lashes them with its whips.
description_pt: Hidden within the bouquet on each hand are thorned whips loaded with virulent poison. Roserade moves gracefully as it corners its prey and mercilessly lashes them with its whips.

name: Cranidos
description_en: An incredibly rare sight. They duel each other by ramming their heads together, and the resulting sound echoes throughout the area like the pealing of a bell.
description_pt: An incredibly rare sight. They duel each other by ramming their heads together, and the resulting sound echoes throughout the area like the pealing of a bell.

name: Rampardos
description_en: Very little is known about its biology. Can knock down massive trees by smashing its beautiful, pearl-like crown against them.
description_pt: Very little is known about its biology. Can knock down massive trees by smashing its beautiful, pearl-like crown against them.

name: Shieldon
description_en: Much remains unknown about this Pokémon, as few have ever seen it. However, we know that it is calm and dislikes conflict, and it enjoys polishing its face against trees and rocks.
description_pt: Much remains unknown about this Pokémon, as few have ever seen it. However, we know that it is calm and dislikes conflict, and it enjoys polishing its face against trees and rocks.

name: Bastiodon
description_en: Its face is sturdy—as strong as diamond—and this hardness offers a very stable defense. Much about this species is still unknown, such as its natural habitat.
description_pt: Its face is sturdy—as strong as diamond—and this hardness offers a very stable defense. Much about this species is still unknown, such as its natural habitat.

name: Burmy
description_en: If its cloak is even slightly damaged, Burmy will immediately repair it with whatever is close at hand. The Pokémon within the cloak is scrawny and vulnerable to the cold.
description_pt: If its cloak is even slightly damaged, Burmy will immediately repair it with whatever is close at hand. The Pokémon within the cloak is scrawny and vulnerable to the cold.

name: Wormadam
description_en: When evolving, its body takes in surrounding materials. As a result, there are many body variations.
description_pt: When evolving, its body takes in surrounding materials. As a result, there are many body variations.

name: Mothim
description_en: Scatters steel-colored scales as it flaps its wings. Despite being observed feeding primarily on the nectar of flowers, Mothim is not often seen around flower gardens.
description_pt: Scatters steel-colored scales as it flaps its wings. Despite being observed feeding primarily on the nectar of flowers, Mothim is not often seen around flower gardens.

name: Combee
description_en: They swear fealty to a queen Pokémon and work diligently to gather nectar. Each swarm produces a different flavor of honey.
description_pt: They swear fealty to a queen Pokémon and work diligently to gather nectar. Each swarm produces a different flavor of honey.

name: Vespiquen
description_en: Commands its subjects to build its hive. It will dispatch any interlopers who dare sneak into its nest and use them as nourishment for itself.
description_pt: Commands its subjects to build its hive. It will dispatch any interlopers who dare sneak into its nest and use them as nourishment for itself.

name: Pachirisu
description_en: A species related to the Pikachu line. Though Pachirisu is a calm Pokémon, it still presents a danger should one touch its electrified tail or cheeks.
description_pt: A species related to the Pikachu line. Though Pachirisu is a calm Pokémon, it still presents a danger should one touch its electrified tail or cheeks.

name: Buizel
description_en: It moves freely in the water by spinning its forked tail for propulsion. The resemblance to the screw of a steamboat is coincidental.
description_pt: It moves freely in the water by spinning its forked tail for propulsion. The resemblance to the screw of a steamboat is coincidental.

name: Floatzel
description_en: Has a long, rather splendid flotation sac, which prevents Floatzel from drowning even in stormy seas. One might glimpse this species around fishing hamlets from time to time.
description_pt: Has a long, rather splendid flotation sac, which prevents Floatzel from drowning even in stormy seas. One might glimpse this species around fishing hamlets from time to time.

name: Cherubi
description_en: Once the fruit growing alongside the main body is large and plump, Cherubi will use the nutrients within to evolve. The fruit then detaches, becoming nourishment for other creatures.
description_pt: Once the fruit growing alongside the main body is large and plump, Cherubi will use the nutrients within to evolve. The fruit then detaches, becoming nourishment for other creatures.

name: Cherrim
description_en: Motionless, save for the occasional quiver. A rich array of Pokémon can be found gathered around it, drawn by the scent exuded from Cherrim's folded petals.
description_pt: Motionless, save for the occasional quiver. A rich array of Pokémon can be found gathered around it, drawn by the scent exuded from Cherrim's folded petals.

name: Shellos
description_en: Found in abundance on seashores bordering warm waters. Shellos are unexpectedly friendly and will crawl toward any person they see. Take care not to get coated in mucus!
description_pt: Found in abundance on seashores bordering warm waters. Shellos are unexpectedly friendly and will crawl toward any person they see. Take care not to get coated in mucus!

name: Gastrodon
description_en: Eats beach sand for nourishment. Should one Gastrodon encounter another of a different color, a fierce battle will inevitably ensue.
description_pt: Eats beach sand for nourishment. Should one Gastrodon encounter another of a different color, a fierce battle will inevitably ensue.

name: Ambipom
description_en: To affirm their kinship, members of this species will form a ring by linking their newly doubled tails together. On rare occasions, humans have been accepted into such rings.
description_pt: To affirm their kinship, members of this species will form a ring by linking their newly doubled tails together. On rare occasions, humans have been accepted into such rings.

name: Drifloon
description_en: Said to lure away young children and carry them off to the afterlife. Some whisper that Drifloon are formed of reincarnated human souls, but these rumors are as yet unconfirmed.
description_pt: Said to lure away young children and carry them off to the afterlife. Some whisper that Drifloon are formed of reincarnated human souls, but these rumors are as yet unconfirmed.

name: Drifblim
description_en: It drifts along at dusk, perfectly silent. Its transient, melancholy aspect touches some people deeply—every so often, one will come upon a song or poem devoted to Drifblim.
description_pt: It drifts along at dusk, perfectly silent. Its transient, melancholy aspect touches some people deeply—every so often, one will come upon a song or poem devoted to Drifblim.

name: Buneary
description_en: My hypothesis as to why Buneary rolls up its ears is that its hearing is far too keen. I surmise that the Pokémon protects its hearing by limiting the sound that may enter its ears.
description_pt: My hypothesis as to why Buneary rolls up its ears is that its hearing is far too keen. I surmise that the Pokémon protects its hearing by limiting the sound that may enter its ears.

name: Lopunny
description_en: Its fur is warm and yet remarkably light. This Pokémon kicks as though it were a master of karate, driving back its opponents with ease.
description_pt: Its fur is warm and yet remarkably light. This Pokémon kicks as though it were a master of karate, driving back its opponents with ease.

name: Mismagius
description_en: The incantations Mismagius chants can ward against misfortune, so a custom exists of inviting it into one's home. Incur the Pokémon's displeasure, however, and disaster will surely ensue.
description_pt: The incantations Mismagius chants can ward against misfortune, so a custom exists of inviting it into one's home. Incur the Pokémon's displeasure, however, and disaster will surely ensue.

name: Honchkrow
description_en: One cry from this Pokémon, and a murder of Murkrow come flying. At such times, one would think the curtain of night had fallen, plunging the world into jet-black darkness.
description_pt: One cry from this Pokémon, and a murder of Murkrow come flying. At such times, one would think the curtain of night had fallen, plunging the world into jet-black darkness.

name: Glameow
description_en: Bewitches humans with its helical tail and piercing gaze. Its hidden claws are quite sharp as well, making this Pokémon an exceedingly tricky opponent if antagonized.
description_pt: Bewitches humans with its helical tail and piercing gaze. Its hidden claws are quite sharp as well, making this Pokémon an exceedingly tricky opponent if antagonized.

name: Purugly
description_en: Though impudent and difficult to tame, Purugly enjoys great popularity due to its fur, the beauty of which surpasses even velveteen.
description_pt: Though impudent and difficult to tame, Purugly enjoys great popularity due to its fur, the beauty of which surpasses even velveteen.

name: Chingling
description_en: This Pokémon gave me an excruciating headache when it seemingly cried out without making a sound. Perhaps there are some sounds that the human ear is simply incapable of hearing.
description_pt: This Pokémon gave me an excruciating headache when it seemingly cried out without making a sound. Perhaps there are some sounds that the human ear is simply incapable of hearing.

name: Stunky
description_en: The poison that gushes from its aft end is accompanied by an utterly evil-smelling odor with such potency that one whiff can induce memory loss.
description_pt: The poison that gushes from its aft end is accompanied by an utterly evil-smelling odor with such potency that one whiff can induce memory loss.

name: Skuntank
description_en: Sprays a poisonous fluid to take down prey. Sometimes, unable to stomach the stench of its own fluid, it leaves the bested prey uneaten.
description_pt: Sprays a poisonous fluid to take down prey. Sometimes, unable to stomach the stench of its own fluid, it leaves the bested prey uneaten.

name: Bronzor
description_en: Floats using a mysterious energy. The pattern engraved upon its back is held as sacred and can sometimes be found in imagery from ancient cemeteries and other such timeworn places.
description_pt: Floats using a mysterious energy. The pattern engraved upon its back is held as sacred and can sometimes be found in imagery from ancient cemeteries and other such timeworn places.

name: Bronzong
description_en: Some believe that its bell-like cry opens holes to another world. It has been revered as a deity since ancient times.
description_pt: Some believe that its bell-like cry opens holes to another world. It has been revered as a deity since ancient times.

name: Bonsly
description_en: Its tears elicit sympathy from those who see them, but do not be deceived! This expulsion of body water is merely a physiological mechanism for keeping itself in good health.
description_pt: Its tears elicit sympathy from those who see them, but do not be deceived! This expulsion of body water is merely a physiological mechanism for keeping itself in good health.

name: Mime Jr.
description_en: Known to turn up in bustling marketplaces now and again. It mimics people much as a child would, then watches how they react, eyes sparkling.
description_pt: Known to turn up in bustling marketplaces now and again. It mimics people much as a child would, then watches how they react, eyes sparkling.

name: Happiny
description_en: In imitation of Chansey, it keeps a round stone tucked into its belly pouch and cherishes it dearly. It gets along well with children and will sometimes play house with them for fun.
description_pt: In imitation of Chansey, it keeps a round stone tucked into its belly pouch and cherishes it dearly. It gets along well with children and will sometimes play house with them for fun.

name: Chatot
description_en: A versatile performer skilled in the imitation of human speech. It is said that older, more experienced Chatot can even understand the meaning of the words they mimic.
description_pt: A versatile performer skilled in the imitation of human speech. It is said that older, more experienced Chatot can even understand the meaning of the words they mimic.

name: Spiritomb
description_en: It lays curses by thinking wicked thoughts. Writings tell that this Pokémon was born out of the assembly of five score and eight malevolent spirits.
description_pt: It lays curses by thinking wicked thoughts. Writings tell that this Pokémon was born out of the assembly of five score and eight malevolent spirits.

name: Gible
description_en: It nests in caves untouched by sunlight. Its sharp teeth may fall out when worn away or after an impact, but they regrow within a few days.
description_pt: It nests in caves untouched by sunlight. Its sharp teeth may fall out when worn away or after an impact, but they regrow within a few days.

name: Gabite
description_en: Though Gabite are usually of a violent disposition, when I gave one a glass bead it had been eyeing covetously, it suddenly became quite docile.
description_pt: Though Gabite are usually of a violent disposition, when I gave one a glass bead it had been eyeing covetously, it suddenly became quite docile.

name: Garchomp
description_en: Soars across the heavens at blinding speed—a magnificent sight! It has a feral disposition. Utmost caution is required if one meets a Garchomp out in the wilds.
description_pt: Soars across the heavens at blinding speed—a magnificent sight! It has a feral disposition. Utmost caution is required if one meets a Garchomp out in the wilds.

name: Munchlax
description_en: Its robust stomach allows it to nonchalantly devour even rotted matter. It pays frequent visits to villages, seeking out food scraps intended for compost.
description_pt: Its robust stomach allows it to nonchalantly devour even rotted matter. It pays frequent visits to villages, seeking out food scraps intended for compost.

name: Riolu
description_en: Though infantile in appearance, it has the mysterious ability to read the minds of humans. The pure of heart are met with Riolu's approval, while those of ill nature earn only its loathing.
description_pt: Though infantile in appearance, it has the mysterious ability to read the minds of humans. The pure of heart are met with Riolu's approval, while those of ill nature earn only its loathing.

name: Lucario
description_en: A most gallant-looking creature. It emits energy waves and controls them with precision, using them to sense even faraway beings. I have given the name ”aura” to this power.
description_pt: A most gallant-looking creature. It emits energy waves and controls them with precision, using them to sense even faraway beings. I have given the name ”aura” to this power.

name: Hippopotas
description_en: Though large and languid, Hippopotas is difficult to detect due to its tendency to burrow into and lurk beneath the soil. When agitated or excited, it expels sand from its nostrils.
description_pt: Though large and languid, Hippopotas is difficult to detect due to its tendency to burrow into and lurk beneath the soil. When agitated or excited, it expels sand from its nostrils.

name: Hippowdon
description_en: Short-tempered and easily moved to violence. It whips up whirlwinds of sand to crush its foes' spirits, then goes in for the attack.
description_pt: Short-tempered and easily moved to violence. It whips up whirlwinds of sand to crush its foes' spirits, then goes in for the attack.

name: Skorupi
description_en: Its claws are not only razor-sharp but poisonous, making Skorupi a highly dangerous Pokémon. It seems to be weakened by cold temperatures, however.
description_pt: Its claws are not only razor-sharp but poisonous, making Skorupi a highly dangerous Pokémon. It seems to be weakened by cold temperatures, however.

name: Drapion
description_en: Has a brutish, ferocious temperament. With immense strength and a sturdy shell off which swords will bounce, it rampages about and wreaks havoc.
description_pt: Has a brutish, ferocious temperament. With immense strength and a sturdy shell off which swords will bounce, it rampages about and wreaks havoc.

name: Croagunk
description_en: A poison wielder with a dastardly personality. Despite such qualities, this species is afforded a measure of popularity due to its peculiar cry and comical features.
description_pt: A poison wielder with a dastardly personality. Despite such qualities, this species is afforded a measure of popularity due to its peculiar cry and comical features.

name: Toxicroak
description_en: Its crimson claws contain a virulent toxin. This toxin can be made into a tonic by diluting it, mixing it with several types of wild grass, and boiling it down over two days.
description_pt: Its crimson claws contain a virulent toxin. This toxin can be made into a tonic by diluting it, mixing it with several types of wild grass, and boiling it down over two days.

name: Carnivine
description_en: Though this is a plant Pokémon, it has a gluttonous and unruly temperament. Carnivine attacks its prey with its cavernous maw wide open.
description_pt: Though this is a plant Pokémon, it has a gluttonous and unruly temperament. Carnivine attacks its prey with its cavernous maw wide open.

name: Finneon
description_en: What a gorgeous sight this Pokémon is as it swims with its long, pink-painted caudal fins fluttering behind it. Finneon's beautiful appearance has led to its nickname: ”finery fish.”
description_pt: What a gorgeous sight this Pokémon is as it swims with its long, pink-painted caudal fins fluttering behind it. Finneon's beautiful appearance has led to its nickname: ”finery fish.”

name: Lumineon
description_en: Uses its gleaming fins to hunt its prey. The view of Lumineon schooling near the surface of the sea at night is breathtaking— it's as though there were shining stars right there.
description_pt: Uses its gleaming fins to hunt its prey. The view of Lumineon schooling near the surface of the sea at night is breathtaking— it's as though there were shining stars right there.

name: Mantyke
description_en: Though ball-like in shape, this Pokémon is a proficient swimmer. I have discovered that if a Mantyke spends much time with schools of Remoraid, it will eventually achieve evolution.
description_pt: Though ball-like in shape, this Pokémon is a proficient swimmer. I have discovered that if a Mantyke spends much time with schools of Remoraid, it will eventually achieve evolution.

name: Snover
description_en: One is likely to encounter this Pokémon while out in the snow. There are stories of Snover appearing in human settlements but doing no harm—rather, they bond with the children.
description_pt: One is likely to encounter this Pokémon while out in the snow. There are stories of Snover appearing in human settlements but doing no harm—rather, they bond with the children.

name: Abomasnow
description_en: A powerful Pokémon that can split huge boulders with ease. Dislikes associating with others and chooses to live quietly deep within the mountains, playing with the snow.
description_pt: A powerful Pokémon that can split huge boulders with ease. Dislikes associating with others and chooses to live quietly deep within the mountains, playing with the snow.

name: Weavile
description_en: This species corners prey as a pack, under the guidance of a leader. Weavile displays increased cunning, leading me to speculate that its evolution caused further brain development.
description_pt: This species corners prey as a pack, under the guidance of a leader. Weavile displays increased cunning, leading me to speculate that its evolution caused further brain development.

name: Magnezone
description_en: I theorize that a special magnetic field influenced this Pokémon, changing its molecular structure and causing it to evolve. It emits strange radio waves toward space from its antenna.
description_pt: I theorize that a special magnetic field influenced this Pokémon, changing its molecular structure and causing it to evolve. It emits strange radio waves toward space from its antenna.

name: Lickilicky
description_en: Its tongue can extend and contract freely, and it is capable of reaching lengths over 10 times Lickilicky's height. Beware of the saliva, as it contains corrosive elements.
description_pt: Its tongue can extend and contract freely, and it is capable of reaching lengths over 10 times Lickilicky's height. Beware of the saliva, as it contains corrosive elements.

name: Rhyperior
description_en: This Pokémon evolved through use of a curious item. Its rocklike hide is composed of a mysterious substance and can withstand a blow from a masterwork sword with nary a scratch.
description_pt: This Pokémon evolved through use of a curious item. Its rocklike hide is composed of a mysterious substance and can withstand a blow from a masterwork sword with nary a scratch.

name: Tangrowth
description_en: Draped with long vines, it resembles a shrub in appearance. It swings bundles of vines as though they were arms, wrapping them around prey to ensnare them.
description_pt: Draped with long vines, it resembles a shrub in appearance. It swings bundles of vines as though they were arms, wrapping them around prey to ensnare them.

name: Electivire
description_en: Its evolution was induced by an unusual item, and its electrical output rises along with its heart rate. From its tails, it can unleash an electric current measuring 20,000 volts.
description_pt: Its evolution was induced by an unusual item, and its electrical output rises along with its heart rate. From its tails, it can unleash an electric current measuring 20,000 volts.

name: Magmortar
description_en: Use of a strange item caused this Pokémon to evolve. Fireballs launched from the ends of its tubelike arms are hot enough to melt an iron pot in an instant.
description_pt: Use of a strange item caused this Pokémon to evolve. Fireballs launched from the ends of its tubelike arms are hot enough to melt an iron pot in an instant.

name: Togekiss
description_en: Scant few have ever sighted this Pokémon. After studying what literature remains, I am certain Togekiss will reveal itself when peace reigns in the land.
description_pt: Scant few have ever sighted this Pokémon. After studying what literature remains, I am certain Togekiss will reveal itself when peace reigns in the land.

name: Yanmega
description_en: Extremely violent. When hunting, it wastes none of its energy, aiming only for prey's most vulnerable spots. Any who manage to tame this Pokémon must be of incredible bravery.
description_pt: Extremely violent. When hunting, it wastes none of its energy, aiming only for prey's most vulnerable spots. Any who manage to tame this Pokémon must be of incredible bravery.

name: Leafeon
description_en: Cells similar to those of plants have been found in its fur. Its hard tail can fell a large tree with one stroke, and the tail's sharpness exceeds even that of a sword crafted by a master.
description_pt: Cells similar to those of plants have been found in its fur. Its hard tail can fell a large tree with one stroke, and the tail's sharpness exceeds even that of a sword crafted by a master.

name: Glaceon
description_en: Glaceon is able to lower its body temperature very quickly. It freezes the atmosphere, creating diamond dust that glitters like gems while it flutters and dances around.
description_pt: Glaceon is able to lower its body temperature very quickly. It freezes the atmosphere, creating diamond dust that glitters like gems while it flutters and dances around.

name: Gliscor
description_en: It glides soundlessly on pitch-black wings and sinks sharp fangs into the throat of its prey. It takes on a look of satisfaction once it has entirely drained its prey of blood.
description_pt: It glides soundlessly on pitch-black wings and sinks sharp fangs into the throat of its prey. It takes on a look of satisfaction once it has entirely drained its prey of blood.

name: Mamoswine
description_en: This species reached its zenith during the period known as the ice age. I suspect that Hisui's frigid climate is in harmony with Mamoswine's constitution, thus awakening hidden potential.
description_pt: This species reached its zenith during the period known as the ice age. I suspect that Hisui's frigid climate is in harmony with Mamoswine's constitution, thus awakening hidden potential.

name: Porygon-Z
description_en: A curious item induced this evolution. The Pokémon's offensive capabilities have greatly increased, but the strangeness of its behavior has magnified in equal measure. This worries me.
description_pt: A curious item induced this evolution. The Pokémon's offensive capabilities have greatly increased, but the strangeness of its behavior has magnified in equal measure. This worries me.

name: Gallade
description_en: The blades extending from its elbows are sharper than the finest swords. Its swordsmanship, albeit self-taught, is astonishingly impressive.
description_pt: The blades extending from its elbows are sharper than the finest swords. Its swordsmanship, albeit self-taught, is astonishingly impressive.

name: Probopass
description_en: It is able to emit powerful magnetism, allowing it control over the iron sand that forms its luscious mustache. Using this iron sand, Probopass forms hard stones with which it smites its prey.
description_pt: It is able to emit powerful magnetism, allowing it control over the iron sand that forms its luscious mustache. Using this iron sand, Probopass forms hard stones with which it smites its prey.

name: Dusknoir
description_en: Comes to those whose lives have come to an end and escorts their souls to the afterlife. Known to mistakenly take the souls of those who yet have life left in them, albeit rarely.
description_pt: Comes to those whose lives have come to an end and escorts their souls to the afterlife. Known to mistakenly take the souls of those who yet have life left in them, albeit rarely.

name: Froslass
description_en: A Pokémon inhabited by the soul of a woman who died bearing a grudge in the snowy mountains. Legends of Froslass placing deathly curses on misbehaving men send shivers down my spine.
description_pt: A Pokémon inhabited by the soul of a woman who died bearing a grudge in the snowy mountains. Legends of Froslass placing deathly curses on misbehaving men send shivers down my spine.

name: Rotom
description_en: This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.
description_pt: This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.

name: Uxie
description_en: A Pokémon feared but also respected for stealing away the memories of evildoers. I have found records that suggest Uxie holds dominion over knowledge.
description_pt: A Pokémon feared but also respected for stealing away the memories of evildoers. I have found records that suggest Uxie holds dominion over knowledge.

name: Mesprit
description_en: Known as the Being of Emotion. In legend, this Pokémon was feared, as any who showed disrespect would have their emotions thrown into disarray.
description_pt: Known as the Being of Emotion. In legend, this Pokémon was feared, as any who showed disrespect would have their emotions thrown into disarray.

name: Azelf
description_en: The dreaded Being of Willpower. Legends tell of this Pokémon manipulating the will of its adversaries and turning them into puppets of its own.
description_pt: The dreaded Being of Willpower. Legends tell of this Pokémon manipulating the will of its adversaries and turning them into puppets of its own.

name: Dialga
description_en: This Pokémon is revered as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Dialga was what caused the vast river of time to begin flowing in our world.
description_pt: This Pokémon is revered as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Dialga was what caused the vast river of time to begin flowing in our world.

name: Palkia
description_en: This Pokémon is feared as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Palkia was what caused the walls of our world to disappear, creating a sky that spans for infinity.
description_pt: This Pokémon is feared as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Palkia was what caused the walls of our world to disappear, creating a sky that spans for infinity.

name: Heatran
description_en: Stories tell of this Pokémon being birthed from the boiling magma within Mount Coronet. Its molten-steel body holds many mysteries.
description_pt: Stories tell of this Pokémon being birthed from the boiling magma within Mount Coronet. Its molten-steel body holds many mysteries.

name: Regigigas
description_en: According to legend, Regigigas pulled landmasses together and bound them with rope to create the continent of Hisui. Though I have my doubts, the story could well contain a shred of truth.
description_pt: According to legend, Regigigas pulled landmasses together and bound them with rope to create the continent of Hisui. Though I have my doubts, the story could well contain a shred of truth.

name: Giratina
description_en: There is one Hisuian verse that tells of a powerful light creating a deep shadow. I imagine that this deep shadow is Giratina.
description_pt: There is one Hisuian verse that tells of a powerful light creating a deep shadow. I imagine that this deep shadow is Giratina.

name: Cresselia
description_en: Cresselia is reminiscent of the crescent moon. It leaves a brilliant line of light in its wake as it flies across the night sky. I daresay it resembles the heavenly maiden who created the Milky Way.
description_pt: Cresselia is reminiscent of the crescent moon. It leaves a brilliant line of light in its wake as it flies across the night sky. I daresay it resembles the heavenly maiden who created the Milky Way.

name: Phione
description_en: Can be seen floating offshore during seasons when the seas are warm. Its azure body blends in with the ocean waters—logic suggests this is a defense mechanism against natural predators.
description_pt: Can be seen floating offshore during seasons when the seas are warm. Its azure body blends in with the ocean waters—logic suggests this is a defense mechanism against natural predators.

name: Manaphy
description_en: Rumored to migrate across the oceans and visit Hisui's coastal waters only rarely. Although Manaphy resembles Phione, it is also quite different. The relation between the two is unclear.
description_pt: Rumored to migrate across the oceans and visit Hisui's coastal waters only rarely. Although Manaphy resembles Phione, it is also quite different. The relation between the two is unclear.

name: Darkrai
description_en: On a moonless night, a strange incident occurred in which every one of a village's inhabitants suffered nightmares. The villagers attested that Darkrai appeared before them in these nightmares.
description_pt: On a moonless night, a strange incident occurred in which every one of a village's inhabitants suffered nightmares. The villagers attested that Darkrai appeared before them in these nightmares.

name: Shaymin
description_en: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.
description_pt: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.

name: Arceus
description_en: It is the heavenly fount from which pours the light that shines across Hisui. Its luminance guides and protects all Pokémon. Hisuian mythology states that Arceus is the creator of all things.
description_pt: It is the heavenly fount from which pours the light that shines across Hisui. Its luminance guides and protects all Pokémon. Hisuian mythology states that Arceus is the creator of all things.

name: Victini
description_en: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.
description_pt: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

name: Snivy
description_en: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.
description_pt: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

name: Servine
description_en: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.
description_pt: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

name: Serperior
description_en: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.
description_pt: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

name: Tepig
description_en: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.
description_pt: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

name: Pignite
description_en: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.
description_pt: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

name: Emboar
description_en: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.
description_pt: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

name: Oshawott
description_en: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.
description_pt: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.

name: Dewott
description_en: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.
description_pt: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

name: Samurott
description_en: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.
description_pt: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

name: Patrat
description_en: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.
description_pt: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

name: Watchog
description_en: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.
description_pt: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

name: Lillipup
description_en: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.
