description_pt: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.

name: Herdier
description_en: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.
description_pt: It has black, cape-like fur that is very hard and decreases the amount of damage it receives.

name: Stoutland
description_en: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.
description_pt: It rescues people stranded by blizzards in the mountains. Its shaggy fur shields it from the cold.

name: Purrloin
description_en: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.
description_pt: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can’t help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

name: Liepard
description_en: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.
description_pt: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.

name: Pansage
description_en: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.
description_pt: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

name: Simisage
description_en: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.
description_pt: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

name: Pansear
description_en: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.
description_pt: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.

name: Simisear
description_en: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.
description_pt: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

name: Panpour
description_en: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.
description_pt: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

name: Simipour
description_en: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.
description_pt: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

name: Munna
description_en: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.
description_pt: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.

name: Musharna
description_en: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.
description_pt: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

name: Pidove
description_en: Each follows its Trainer’s orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.
description_pt: Each follows its Trainer’s orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

name: Tranquill
description_en: It can return to its Trainer’s location regardless of the distance separating them.
description_pt: It can return to its Trainer’s location regardless of the distance separating them.

name: Unfezant
description_en: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.
description_pt: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females’ flying abilities surpass those of the males.

name: Blitzle
description_en: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.
description_pt: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

name: Zebstrika
description_en: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.
description_pt: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

name: Roggenrola
description_en: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.
description_pt: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

name: Boldore
description_en: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.
description_pt: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.

name: Gigalith
description_en: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.
description_pt: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

name: Woobat
description_en: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.
description_pt: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

name: Swoobat
description_en: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.
description_pt: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.

name: Drilbur
description_en: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.
description_pt: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

name: Excadrill
description_en: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.
description_pt: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

name: Audino
description_en: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.
description_pt: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

name: Timburr
description_en: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.
description_pt: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

name: Gurdurr
description_en: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.
description_pt: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

name: Conkeldurr
description_en: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.
description_pt: It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

name: Tympole
description_en: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.
description_pt: They warn others of danger by vibrating their cheeks to create a high-pitched sound.

name: Palpitoad
description_en: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.
description_pt: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

name: Seismitoad
description_en: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.
description_pt: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

name: Throh
description_en: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.
description_pt: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

name: Sawk
description_en: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.
description_pt: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.

name: Sewaddle
description_en: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.
description_pt: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

name: Swadloon
description_en: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
description_pt: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

name: Leavanny
description_en: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.
description_pt: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

name: Venipede
description_en: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.
description_pt: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

name: Whirlipede
description_en: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
description_pt: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

name: Scolipede
description_en: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.
description_pt: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

name: Cottonee
description_en: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.
description_pt: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.

name: Whimsicott
description_en: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.
description_pt: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.

name: Petilil
description_en: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.
description_pt: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.

name: Lilligant
description_en: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.
description_pt: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

name: Basculin
description_en: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.
description_pt: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

name: Sandile
description_en: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.
description_pt: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.

name: Krokorok
description_en: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.
description_pt: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

name: Krookodile
description_en: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.
description_pt: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

name: Darumaka
description_en: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.
description_pt: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.

name: Darmanitan
description_en: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.
description_pt: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

name: Maractus
description_en: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.
description_pt: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

name: Dwebble
description_en: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.
description_pt: This Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

name: Crustle
description_en: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.
description_pt: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.

name: Scraggy
description_en: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
description_pt: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

name: Scrafty
description_en: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.
description_pt: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

name: Sigilyph
description_en: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.
description_pt: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.

name: Yamask
description_en: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.
description_pt: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

name: Cofagrigus
description_en: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.
description_pt: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

name: Tirtouga
description_en: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.
description_pt: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.

name: Carracosta
description_en: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.
description_pt: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.

name: Archen
description_en: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.
description_pt: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

name: Archeops
description_en: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.
description_pt: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.

name: Trubbish
description_en: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.
description_pt: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

name: Garbodor
description_en: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.
description_pt: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.

name: Zorua
description_en: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.
description_pt: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

name: Zoroark
description_en: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.
description_pt: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

name: Minccino
description_en: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.
description_pt: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

name: Cinccino
description_en: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.
description_pt: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

name: Gothita
description_en: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.
description_pt: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

name: Gothorita
description_en: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.
description_pt: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

name: Gothitelle
description_en: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.
description_pt: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

name: Solosis
description_en: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.
description_pt: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

name: Duosion
description_en: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.
description_pt: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

name: Reuniclus
description_en: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.
description_pt: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

name: Ducklett
description_en: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.
description_pt: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.

name: Swanna
description_en: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
description_pt: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

name: Vanillite
description_en: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.
description_pt: The temperature of their breath is -58° F. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them.

name: Vanillish
description_en: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon’s habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.
description_pt: Snowy mountains are this Pokémon’s habitat. During an ancient ice age, they moved to southern areas.

name: Vanilluxe
description_en: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.
description_pt: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and attack their foes with violent blizzards.

name: Deerling
description_en: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.
description_pt: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.

name: Sawsbuck
description_en: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.
description_pt: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.

name: Emolga
description_en: The energy made in its cheeks’ electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.
description_pt: The energy made in its cheeks’ electric pouches is stored inside its membrane and released while it is gliding.

name: Karrablast
description_en: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.
description_pt: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

name: Escavalier
description_en: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.
description_pt: They fly around at high speed, striking with their pointed spears. Even when in trouble, they face opponents bravely.

name: Foongus
description_en: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.
description_pt: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

name: Amoonguss
description_en: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.
description_pt: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.

name: Frillish
description_en: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.
description_pt: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.

name: Jellicent
description_en: The fate of the ships and crew that wander into Jellicent’s habitat: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.
description_pt: The fate of the ships and crew that wander into Jellicent’s habitat: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.

name: Alomomola
description_en: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.
description_pt: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.

name: Joltik
description_en: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.
description_pt: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.

name: Galvantula
description_en: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.
description_pt: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

name: Ferroseed
description_en: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.
description_pt: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.

name: Ferrothorn
description_en: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.
description_pt: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.

name: Klink
description_en: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.
description_pt: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

name: Klang
description_en: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.
description_pt: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.

name: Klinklang
description_en: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.
description_pt: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.

name: Tynamo
description_en: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
description_pt: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

name: Eelektrik
description_en: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.
description_pt: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

name: Eelektross
description_en: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.
description_pt: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

name: Elgyem
description_en: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent’s brain, causing unendurable headaches.
description_pt: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent’s brain, causing unendurable headaches.

name: Beheeyem
description_en: It can manipulate an opponent’s memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.
description_pt: It can manipulate an opponent’s memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three different-colored fingers.

name: Litwick
description_en: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.
description_pt: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

name: Lampent
description_en: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.
description_pt: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.

name: Chandelure
description_en: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.
description_pt: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

name: Axew
description_en: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.
description_pt: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

name: Fraxure
description_en: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they’ve been fighting.
description_pt: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they’ve been fighting.

name: Haxorus
description_en: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.
description_pt: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

name: Cubchoo
description_en: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.
description_pt: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.

name: Beartic
description_en: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.
description_pt: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

name: Cryogonal
description_en: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.
description_pt: When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.

name: Shelmet
description_en: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.
description_pt: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It can spit a sticky, poisonous liquid.

name: Accelgor
description_en: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.
description_pt: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in many layers of thin membrane.

name: Stunfisk
description_en: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.
description_pt: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

name: Mienfoo
description_en: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.
description_pt: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

name: Mienshao
description_en: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.
description_pt: It wields the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

name: Druddigon
description_en: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.
description_pt: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

name: Golett
description_en: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.
description_pt: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

name: Golurk
description_en: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.
description_pt: It flies across the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

name: Pawniard
description_en: Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.
description_pt: Blades comprise this Pokémon’s entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

name: Bisharp
description_en: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.
description_pt: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.

name: Bouffalant
description_en: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.
description_pt: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

name: Rufflet
description_en: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.
description_pt: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

name: Braviary
description_en: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.
description_pt: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

name: Vullaby
description_en: Their wings are too tiny to allow them to fly. They guard their posteriors with bones that were gathered by Mandibuzz.
description_pt: Their wings are too tiny to allow them to fly. They guard their posteriors with bones that were gathered by Mandibuzz.

name: Mandibuzz
description_en: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.
description_pt: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.

name: Heatmor
description_en: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.
description_pt: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. Durant is its prey.

name: Durant
description_en: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.
description_pt: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

name: Deino
description_en: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.
description_pt: It tends to bite everything, and it is not a picky eater. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

name: Zweilous
description_en: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.
description_pt: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

name: Hydreigon
description_en: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.
description_pt: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.

name: Larvesta
description_en: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.
description_pt: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.

name: Volcarona
description_en: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona’s fire provided a replacement for the sun.
description_pt: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona’s fire provided a replacement for the sun.

name: Cobalion
description_en: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.
description_pt: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.

name: Terrakion
description_en: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.
description_pt: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

name: Virizion
description_en: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.
description_pt: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.

name: Tornadus
description_en: This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. I suspect its humanlike form to be a false one.
description_pt: This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. I suspect its humanlike form to be a false one.

name: Thundurus
description_en: They say this wielder of electricity has waged war with its nemesis, Tornadus, since time immemorial. The lightning bolts it hurls pierce the very earth and enrich the soil.
description_pt: They say this wielder of electricity has waged war with its nemesis, Tornadus, since time immemorial. The lightning bolts it hurls pierce the very earth and enrich the soil.

name: Reshiram
description_en: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.
description_pt: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

name: Zekrom
description_en: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.
description_pt: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.

name: Landorus
description_en: When the incarnations of wind and of lightning clash, Landorus arrives to quell the conflict. After the tempests and thunderbolts abate, the land is sure to be blessed with bountiful harvests.
description_pt: When the incarnations of wind and of lightning clash, Landorus arrives to quell the conflict. After the tempests and thunderbolts abate, the land is sure to be blessed with bountiful harvests.

name: Kyurem
description_en: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.
description_pt: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

name: Keldeo
description_en: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.
description_pt: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.

name: Meloetta
description_en: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.
description_pt: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

name: Genesect
description_en: Over 300 million years ago, it was feared as the strongest of hunters. It has been modified by Team Plasma.
description_pt: Over 300 million years ago, it was feared as the strongest of hunters. It has been modified by Team Plasma.

name: Chespin
description_en: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.
description_pt: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

name: Quilladin
description_en: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators’ attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.
description_pt: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators’ attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.

name: Chesnaught
description_en: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.
description_pt: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

name: Fennekin
description_en: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.
description_pt: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Braixen
description_en: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.
description_pt: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.

name: Delphox
description_en: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.
description_pt: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.

name: Froakie
description_en: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.
description_pt: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

name: Frogadier
description_en: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
description_pt: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

name: Greninja
description_en: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.
description_pt: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

name: Bunnelby
description_en: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.
description_pt: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

name: Diggersby
description_en: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.
description_pt: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.

name: Fletchling
description_en: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.
description_pt: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

name: Fletchinder
description_en: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.
description_pt: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.

name: Talonflame
description_en: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.
description_pt: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.

name: Scatterbug
description_en: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.
description_pt: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.

name: Spewpa
description_en: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.
description_pt: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.

name: Vivillon
description_en: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.
description_pt: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.

name: Litleo
description_en: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.
description_pt: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.

name: Pyroar
description_en: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.
description_pt: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.

name: Flabébé
description_en: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.
description_pt: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.

name: Floette
description_en: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.
description_pt: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

name: Florges
description_en: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.
description_pt: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

name: Skiddo
description_en: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
description_pt: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

name: Gogoat
description_en: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.
description_pt: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.

name: Pancham
description_en: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.
description_pt: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.

name: Pangoro
description_en: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won’t put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.
description_pt: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won’t put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.

name: Furfrou
description_en: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
description_pt: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

name: Espurr
description_en: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.
description_pt: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

name: Meowstic
description_en: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.
description_pt: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

name: Honedge
description_en: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.
description_pt: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

name: Doublade
description_en: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.
description_pt: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.

name: Aegislash
description_en: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.
description_pt: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.

name: Spritzee
description_en: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.
description_pt: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

name: Aromatisse
description_en: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.
description_pt: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.

name: Swirlix
description_en: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.
description_pt: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.

name: Slurpuff
description_en: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.
description_pt: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

name: Inkay
description_en: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.
description_pt: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

name: Malamar
description_en: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.
description_pt: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.

name: Binacle
description_en: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.
description_pt: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.

name: Barbaracle
description_en: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.
description_pt: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.

name: Skrelp
description_en: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.
description_pt: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.

name: Dragalge
description_en: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.
description_pt: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.

name: Clauncher
description_en: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.
description_pt: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.

name: Clawitzer
description_en: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.
description_pt: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.

name: Helioptile
description_en: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.
description_pt: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

name: Heliolisk
description_en: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.
description_pt: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

name: Tyrunt
description_en: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn’t like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.
description_pt: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn’t like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.

name: Tyrantrum
description_en: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.
description_pt: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.

name: Amaura
description_en: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.
description_pt: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.

name: Aurorus
description_en: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.
description_pt: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.

name: Sylveon
description_en: It emits a soothing aura from its ribbon-shaped organs. It wraps these appendages around quarrelers to instantly restore calm to the situation.
description_pt: It emits a soothing aura from its ribbon-shaped organs. It wraps these appendages around quarrelers to instantly restore calm to the situation.

name: Hawlucha
description_en: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.
description_pt: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.

name: Dedenne
description_en: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.
description_pt: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

name: Carbink
description_en: Born from the temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.
description_pt: Born from the temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.

name: Goomy
description_en: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.
description_pt: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.

name: Sliggoo
description_en: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.
description_pt: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

name: Goodra
description_en: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.
description_pt: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

name: Klefki
description_en: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.
description_pt: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.

name: Phantump
description_en: These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.
description_pt: These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.

name: Trevenant
description_en: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.
description_pt: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.

name: Pumpkaboo
description_en: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.
description_pt: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

name: Gourgeist
description_en: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.
description_pt: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.

name: Bergmite
description_en: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.
description_pt: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.

name: Avalugg
description_en: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.
description_pt: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

name: Noibat
description_en: They live in pitch-black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.
description_pt: They live in pitch-black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.

name: Noivern
description_en: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.
description_pt: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.

name: Xerneas
description_en: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.
description_pt: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

name: Yveltal
description_en: When this legendary Pokémon’s wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.
description_pt: When this legendary Pokémon’s wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.

name: Zygarde
description_en: When the Kalos region’s ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.
description_pt: When the Kalos region’s ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.

name: Diancie
description_en: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.
description_pt: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

name: Hoopa
description_en: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.
description_pt: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.

name: Volcanion
description_en: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It’s said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.
description_pt: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It’s said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

name: Rowlet
description_en: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.
description_pt: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.

name: Dartrix
description_en: Regularly basks in sunlight to gather power—presumably due to the frigid climate. Nonetheless, the edges of the blade quills set into its wings are keen as ever.
description_pt: Regularly basks in sunlight to gather power—presumably due to the frigid climate. Nonetheless, the edges of the blade quills set into its wings are keen as ever.

name: Decidueye
description_en: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.
description_pt: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.

name: Litten
description_en: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.
description_pt: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

name: Torracat
description_en: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.
description_pt: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.

name: Incineroar
description_en: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it’s not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer’s orders with complete nonchalance.
description_pt: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it’s not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer’s orders with complete nonchalance.

name: Popplio
description_en: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It’s famous for being a hard worker.
description_pt: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It’s famous for being a hard worker.

name: Brionne
description_en: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards its enemies.
description_pt: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards its enemies.

name: Primarina
description_en: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learned from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.
description_pt: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learned from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.

name: Pikipek
description_en: It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses the holes for food storage and for nesting.
description_pt: It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses the holes for food storage and for nesting.

name: Trumbeak
description_en: It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak. When it encounters enemies or prey, it fires off all the seeds in a burst.
description_pt: It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak. When it encounters enemies or prey, it fires off all the seeds in a burst.

name: Toucannon
description_en: When it battles, its beak heats up. The temperature can easily exceed 212 degrees Fahrenheit, causing severe burns when it hits.
description_pt: When it battles, its beak heats up. The temperature can easily exceed 212 degrees Fahrenheit, causing severe burns when it hits.

name: Yungoos
description_en: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.
description_pt: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.

name: Gumshoos
description_en: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it’s always snoozing by nightfall.
description_pt: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it’s always snoozing by nightfall.

name: Grubbin
description_en: Its strong jaw enables it to scrape trees and slurp out the sap. It normally lives underground.
description_pt: Its strong jaw enables it to scrape trees and slurp out the sap. It normally lives underground.

name: Charjabug
description_en: Its body is capable of storing electricity. On camping trips, people are grateful to have one around.
description_pt: Its body is capable of storing electricity. On camping trips, people are grateful to have one around.

name: Vikavolt
description_en: It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.
description_pt: It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.

name: Crabrawler
description_en: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.
description_pt: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.

name: Crabominable
description_en: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.
description_pt: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.

name: Oricorio
description_en: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.
description_pt: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.

name: Cutiefly
description_en: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it’s able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.
description_pt: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it’s able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

name: Ribombee
description_en: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.
description_pt: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.

name: Rockruff
description_en: It’s considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.
description_pt: It’s considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.

name: Lycanroc
description_en: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.
description_pt: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.

name: Wishiwashi
description_en: When it’s in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.
description_pt: When it’s in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.

name: Mareanie
description_en: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.
description_pt: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

name: Toxapex
description_en: Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.
description_pt: Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.

name: Mudbray
description_en: The mud stuck to Mudbray’s hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.
description_pt: The mud stuck to Mudbray’s hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.

name: Mudsdale
description_en: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.
description_pt: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.

name: Dewpider
description_en: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.
description_pt: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

name: Araquanid
description_en: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.
description_pt: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

name: Fomantis
description_en: During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. When night falls, it walks around looking for a safer place to sleep.
description_pt: During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. When night falls, it walks around looking for a safer place to sleep.

name: Lurantis
description_en: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis’s vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.
description_pt: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis’s vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.

name: Morelull
description_en: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.
description_pt: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

name: Shiinotic
description_en: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.
description_pt: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.

name: Salandit
description_en: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.
description_pt: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

name: Salazzle
description_en: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.
description_pt: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

name: Stufful
description_en: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.
description_pt: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

name: Bewear
description_en: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.
description_pt: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

name: Bounsweet
description_en: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.
description_pt: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.

name: Steenee
description_en: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.
description_pt: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.

name: Tsareena
description_en: Its long, striking legs aren’t just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.
description_pt: Its long, striking legs aren’t just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.

name: Comfey
description_en: It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine. This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off an aromatic scent.
description_pt: It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine. This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off an aromatic scent.

name: Oranguru
description_en: Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokémon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it’s best suited to veteran Trainers.
description_pt: Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokémon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it’s best suited to veteran Trainers.

name: Passimian
description_en: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.
description_pt: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.

name: Wimpod
description_en: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.
description_pt: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

name: Golisopod
description_en: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.
description_pt: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.

name: Sandygast
description_en: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.
description_pt: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.

name: Palossand
description_en: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.
description_pt: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.

name: Pyukumuku
description_en: It’s covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist, allowing it to stay on land for days without drying up.
description_pt: It’s covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist, allowing it to stay on land for days without drying up.

name: Type: Null
description_en: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.
description_pt: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokémon has some hidden special power.

name: Silvally
description_en: Its trust in its partner is what awakens it. This Pokémon is capable of changing its type, a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.
description_pt: Its trust in its partner is what awakens it. This Pokémon is capable of changing its type, a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.

name: Minior
description_en: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.
description_pt: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.

name: Komala
description_en: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.
description_pt: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

name: Turtonator
description_en: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.
description_pt: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.

name: Togedemaru
description_en: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.
description_pt: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.

name: Mimikyu
description_en: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.
description_pt: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.

name: Bruxish
description_en: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.
description_pt: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.

name: Drampa
description_en: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.
description_pt: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.

name: Dhelmise
description_en: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.
description_pt: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.

name: Jangmo-o
description_en: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.
description_pt: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.

name: Hakamo-o
description_en: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.
description_pt: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.

name: Kommo-o
description_en: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.
description_pt: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.

name: Tapu Koko
description_en: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.
description_pt: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.

name: Tapu Lele
description_en: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.
description_pt: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.

name: Tapu Bulu
description_en: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.
description_pt: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.

name: Tapu Fini
description_en: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.
description_pt: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.

name: Cosmog
description_en: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.
description_pt: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

name: Cosmoem
description_en: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.
description_pt: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.

name: Solgaleo
description_en: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.
