description_pt: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.

name: Lunala
description_en: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.
description_pt: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.

name: Nihilego
description_en: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. People on the street report observing those infested by it suddenly becoming violent.
description_pt: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. People on the street report observing those infested by it suddenly becoming violent.

name: Buzzwole
description_en: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.
description_pt: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.

name: Pheromosa
description_en: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been spotted running across the land at terrific speeds.
description_pt: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been spotted running across the land at terrific speeds.

name: Xurkitree
description_en: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.
description_pt: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.

name: Celesteela
description_en: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses observed it flying across the sky at high speed.
description_pt: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses observed it flying across the sky at high speed.

name: Kartana
description_en: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.
description_pt: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.

name: Guzzlord
description_en: It has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. It’s one of the Ultra Beasts.
description_pt: It has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. It’s one of the Ultra Beasts.

name: Necrozma
description_en: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.
description_pt: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.

name: Magearna
description_en: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.
description_pt: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.

name: Marshadow
description_en: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.
description_pt: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.

name: Poipole
description_en: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.
description_pt: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

name: Naganadel
description_en: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.
description_pt: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.

name: Stakataka
description_en: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.
description_pt: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

name: Blacephalon
description_en: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It’s apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.
description_pt: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It’s apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: Zeraora
description_en: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they’ll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.
description_pt: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they’ll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

name: Meltan
description_en: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.
description_pt: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

name: Melmetal
description_en: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.
description_pt: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

name: Grookey
description_en: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.
description_pt: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

name: Thwackey
description_en: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.
description_pt: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

name: Rillaboom
description_en: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.
description_pt: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

name: Scorbunny
description_en: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon’s body. Once that happens, it’s ready to fight at full power.
description_pt: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon’s body. Once that happens, it’s ready to fight at full power.

name: Raboot
description_en: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.
description_pt: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.

name: Cinderace
description_en: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.
description_pt: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.

name: Sobble
description_en: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won’t be able to resist weeping.
description_pt: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won’t be able to resist weeping.

name: Drizzile
description_en: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.
description_pt: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

name: Inteleon
description_en: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.
description_pt: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

name: Skwovet
description_en: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.
description_pt: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

name: Greedent
description_en: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn’t notice the loss.
description_pt: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn’t notice the loss.

name: Rookidee
description_en: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.
description_pt: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

name: Corvisquire
description_en: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.
description_pt: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

name: Corviknight
description_en: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.
description_pt: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

name: Blipbug
description_en: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn’t.
description_pt: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn’t.

name: Dottler
description_en: It barely moves, but it’s still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.
description_pt: It barely moves, but it’s still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.

name: Orbeetle
description_en: It’s famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.
description_pt: It’s famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.

name: Nickit
description_en: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.
description_pt: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

name: Thievul
description_en: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.
description_pt: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

name: Gossifleur
description_en: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.
description_pt: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.

name: Eldegoss
description_en: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.
description_pt: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.

name: Wooloo
description_en: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.
description_pt: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

name: Dubwool
description_en: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You’ll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.
description_pt: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You’ll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.

name: Chewtle
description_en: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.
description_pt: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.

name: Drednaw
description_en: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.
description_pt: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

name: Yamper
description_en: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.
description_pt: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

name: Boltund
description_en: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.
description_pt: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

name: Rolycoly
description_en: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.
description_pt: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

name: Carkol
description_en: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.
description_pt: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

name: Coalossal
description_en: It’s usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.
description_pt: It’s usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Applin
description_en: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it’s just an apple and nothing more.
description_pt: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it’s just an apple and nothing more.

name: Flapple
description_en: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.
description_pt: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

name: Appletun
description_en: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.
description_pt: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.

name: Silicobra
description_en: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.
description_pt: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.

name: Sandaconda
description_en: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.
description_pt: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.

name: Cramorant
description_en: It’s so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it’s battling midfight.
description_pt: It’s so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it’s battling midfight.

name: Arrokuda
description_en: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It’s very proud of that jaw.
description_pt: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It’s very proud of that jaw.

name: Barraskewda
description_en: This Pokémon has a jaw that’s as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda’s flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.
description_pt: This Pokémon has a jaw that’s as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda’s flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

name: Toxel
description_en: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.
description_pt: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

name: Toxtricity
description_en: When this Pokémon sounds as if it’s strumming a guitar, it’s actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.
description_pt: When this Pokémon sounds as if it’s strumming a guitar, it’s actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

name: Sizzlipede
description_en: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.
description_pt: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

name: Centiskorch
description_en: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.
description_pt: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

name: Clobbopus
description_en: It’s very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.
description_pt: It’s very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

name: Grapploct
description_en: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.
description_pt: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

name: Sinistea
description_en: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.
description_pt: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

name: Polteageist
description_en: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.
description_pt: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

name: Hatenna
description_en: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures’ emotions. If you don’t have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.
description_pt: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures’ emotions. If you don’t have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

name: Hattrem
description_en: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.
description_pt: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

name: Hatterene
description_en: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.
description_pt: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

name: Impidimp
description_en: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.
description_pt: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

name: Morgrem
description_en: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it’s trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.
description_pt: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it’s trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

name: Grimmsnarl
description_en: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.
description_pt: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

name: Obstagoon
description_en: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.
description_pt: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.

name: Perrserker
description_en: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.
description_pt: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

name: Cursola
description_en: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon’s core spirit.
description_pt: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon’s core spirit.

name: Sirfetch’d
description_en: Only Farfetch’d that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon’s leek withers, it will retire from combat.
description_pt: Only Farfetch’d that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon’s leek withers, it will retire from combat.

name: Mr. Rime
description_en: It’s highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.
description_pt: It’s highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

name: Runerigus
description_en: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.
description_pt: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

name: Milcery
description_en: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.
description_pt: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

name: Alcremie
description_en: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it’s decorated with cream.
description_pt: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it’s decorated with cream.

name: Falinks
description_en: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass’s orders are absolute.
description_pt: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass’s orders are absolute.

name: Pincurchin
description_en: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.
description_pt: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

name: Snom
description_en: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.
description_pt: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.

name: Frosmoth
description_en: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains. The temperature of its wings is less than −290 degrees Fahrenheit.
description_pt: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains. The temperature of its wings is less than −290 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Stonjourner
description_en: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun’s descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.
description_pt: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun’s descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

name: Eiscue
description_en: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.
description_pt: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

name: Indeedee
description_en: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.
description_pt: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.

name: Morpeko
description_en: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It’s also generating electricity.
description_pt: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It’s also generating electricity.

name: Cufant
description_en: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It’s also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.
description_pt: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It’s also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

name: Copperajah
description_en: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.
description_pt: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

name: Dracozolt
description_en: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.
description_pt: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

name: Arctozolt
description_en: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.
description_pt: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

name: Dracovish
description_en: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.
description_pt: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

name: Arctovish
description_en: Though it’s able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.
description_pt: Though it’s able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

name: Duraludon
description_en: Its body resembles polished metal, and it’s both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.
description_pt: Its body resembles polished metal, and it’s both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

name: Dreepy
description_en: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.
description_pt: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

name: Drakloak
description_en: It’s capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.
description_pt: It’s capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

name: Dragapult
description_en: When it isn’t battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.
description_pt: When it isn’t battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

name: Zacian
description_en: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.
description_pt: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.

name: Zamazenta
description_en: In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.
description_pt: In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.

name: Eternatus
description_en: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.
description_pt: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

name: Kubfu
description_en: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.
description_pt: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.

name: Urshifu
description_en: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.
description_pt: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

name: Zarude
description_en: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It’s incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.
description_pt: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It’s incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.

name: Regieleki
description_en: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It’s said that removing the rings on Regieleki’s body will unleash the Pokémon’s latent power.
description_pt: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It’s said that removing the rings on Regieleki’s body will unleash the Pokémon’s latent power.

name: Regidrago
description_en: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago’s arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.
description_pt: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago’s arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.

name: Glastrier
description_en: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It’s also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.
description_pt: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It’s also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.

name: Spectrier
description_en: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn’t use its sense of sight. Spectrier’s kicks are said to separate soul from body.
description_pt: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn’t use its sense of sight. Spectrier’s kicks are said to separate soul from body.

name: Calyrex
description_en: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.
description_pt: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.

name: Wyrdeer
description_en: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.
description_pt: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

name: Kleavor
description_en: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.
description_pt: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

name: Ursaluna
description_en: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.
description_pt: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

name: Basculegion
description_en: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.
description_pt: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

name: Sneasler
description_en: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.
description_pt: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

name: Overqwil
description_en: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.
description_pt: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

name: Enamorus
description_en: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.
